newsitem.title: USA: IWI seeks financing, auditors raise doubts.
newsitem.headline: IWI seeks financing, auditors raise doubts.

text.p: IWI Holding Ltd said on Friday it is seeking ongoing financing from lenders.

The company said its auditors have raised concern about its ability to remain a going concern because IWI reported operating losses in both 1995 and 1996 and because IWI's principal lender has not committed to ongoing financing, the company said.
IWI earlier said it lost $1.3 million, or $0.49 a share, in the fourth quarter ended December 31 versus a net loss of $1.9 million, or $0.72 a share, a year earlier.

"Management is actively seeking to maintain a commitment for continuation of its bank operating facilities for a least another year and is exploring raising capital through the issuance of equity related securities," IWI said in a statement.
The company said it has reduced monthly operating expenses and has reduced inventory in an effort to return to profitability and improve liquidity.
